name: OBDex generic DTC enriched JSON
kind: DTC generic, symptoms, common causes, source links
license: CC0-1.0 for data; MIT for code
scope: Approximately 9,533 generic code entries; English/German. Verify upstream completeness and fields at import.
caveat: Third-party clinical-like diagnostic statements are hypotheses, not definitive faults. Never conflate generic and manufacturer-specific DTC meaning.

name: OBDex OBD Mode 01 PID descriptions
scope: SAE-style live-data PID definitions; verify formula semantics and adapter support.
caveat: Only decode PIDs reported supported by actual ECU; never infer a reading from catalog presence.

name: OBDex OBD Mode 09 PID descriptions
scope: Vehicle information PIDs; confirm exact payload format before decoder integration.
caveat: VIN and calibration identifiers are sensitive vehicle data; don't upload without user consent.

name: Wal33D offline DTC SQLite (generic + manufacturer)
license: MIT (repository; review included license and source terms)
scope: Readme database snapshot claims 18,805 definition rows, 9,390 manufacturer-specific, 33 brands; overview headline differs. Count actual downloaded rows.
caveat: Do not merge manufacturer-specific code definitions by code alone: make/model/year/ECU matter. Audit conflicts and provenance before release.

name: DOE/EPA FuelEconomy vehicle records
kind: make/model/year, engine and drivetrain descriptors, EPA consumption
license: US government data; verify data.gov metadata and redistribution conditions for production
scope: US vehicle fuel-economy records model years 1984-2026, with future preliminary coverage; trim resolution varies.
caveat: EPA configuration is NOT a reliable VIN decoder, exact engine identity, repair specification, or maintenance schedule.

name: DOE/EPA emissions linked vehicle records
license: US government data; verify production terms
scope: Supplementary emissions table linked to vehicle IDs; not automatically joined by this starter.
caveat: Do not present emissions data as repair diagnosis.

name: NHTSA recall flat file 2010 onward
license: Federal publication; verify included attachments/field-level terms
scope: Approx 14 MB compressed as published 2026-11-18; download refreshed snapshots.
caveat: A recall campaign matching a model is not proof that a specific VIN is affected or unrepaired. Online VIN check is required.

name: NHTSA recall flat file pre-2010
license: Federal publication; review current source terms
caveat: Historical reference, not live open-recall status.

name: NHTSA NCAP SaferCar ratings CSV
kind: crash safety ratings and selected safety features
license: Federal publication; verify URL from live site before enabling
scope: Public crash safety rating bulk CSV, reported approximately 9 MB in Nov 2026.
caveat: The official download URL was verified via NHTSA site; safety ratings are not a diagnostic test.

name: NHTSA manufacturer communications received 2025-2026
authority: NHTSA federal government with manufacturer-authored content
license: Metadata generally public; manufacturer documents may retain copyright; review reuse rights
scope: Approx 5 MB compressed on NHTSA index 2026-11-18.
caveat: Metadata is not equivalent to licensed full service manual text, and data incomplete.

name: NHTSA TSBs received 2025-2026
authority: NHTSA federal government with manufacturer-authored content
license: Review manufacturer-authored content licensing and allowed redistribution
scope: Approx 12 MB compressed on NHTSA index 2026-11-18.
caveat: TSBs are not recalls; publication may not apply to exact vehicle build. Keep original bulletin ID and source URL.

name: NHTSA ODI investigations
caveat: Investigation does not prove vehicle defect.

name: NHTSA owner complaints all years
license: US government publication; user reports contain privacy considerations
scope: Approx 360 MB compressed as of 2026-11-18; use backend and deduplicate/anonymize.
caveat: Unverified reports must NEVER be presented as confirmed failures; potential personal info; require privacy review.
